name: stepper-nav
title: Stepper Nav
description: Step-progress navigation: a horizontal or vertical row/column of numbered step indicators joined by connectors. Each step's status is active (the current index), completed (before it), upcoming (after it), or an explicit error override. Renders a real <nav>/<ol> landmark with aria-current=step; SR-only Completed:/Error: prefixes carry progress without colour. Controlled-first activeStep + onStepChange (legacy hbd:change { step, label }) with defaultActiveStep fallback. Non-linear mode renders completed/error indicators as real <button>s that move the active step on click. Compound <StepperNav> + <StepperNav.Step> or a data-driven steps[] prop.
